artifacts.label: package-review-progress
artifacts.note: Emitted during the completeness review execution. data.status must be 'running'. The review skill runs the validator script first, then supplements with manual review.

artifacts.label: package-review-report
artifacts.note: Emitted when the completeness review is complete. data must include status (PASS/PASS_WITH_CONCERNS/FAIL), release_readiness, score_average, p0_blockers, p1_warnings, summary, and report_path. Review result does not remove packaging authority — user may still choose to proceed regardless of verdict.
